description: This file defines the 'GetRelatedOne' class, which implements a method operation for the Minilang framework used in Apache OFBiz. It specifically handles the <get-related-one> element, enabling retrieval of a related entity in the entity-relationship model, with caching options and dependency on other entity operations.

classes.name: GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Implements a method operation for the <get-related-one> element in Minilang, facilitating retrieval of a single related entity value with support for caching and dynamic relation name expansion.

classes.name: GetRelatedOneFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of GetRelatedOne based on XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation to retrieve a related entity and sets it in the method environment map.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects entity name information for artifact analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <get-related-one> element with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GetRelatedOne instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the <get-related-one> element.
